correctness.rationale: For all positive coefficients with gr=1 and each c in (0,1), b=(1-c)/a makes the transformed rear constant term equal c times its original; the front-generation coefficients cancel a_h b for both stimulus states. Both diffusion differences scale by c. The new gamma=gamma/c cancels the output difference factor, proving exact tip trajectories and crossing times for every switching input and matched equilibrium initialization. The six-combination x,y normal form follows by direct substitution, and the resulting parameter sensitivity has a strictly nonzero null tangent. The actual embedded checker symbolically confirms all identities and verifies the paper fit as an exact rational within the stated bounds. No finite check is used as an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The motivating biological paper interprets seven numerical fitted coefficients as plausible mechanistic generation, decomposition, diffusion and movement parameters. A continuous exact family inside its own parameter bounds (including >100-fold variation of an inferred generation rate) gives identical motion not only for the nine-day protocol but for every stimulation schedule. This is an unremovable inferential limitation of the stated observation model, not a routine algebraic consistency check; the six-parameter observable normal form directly guides better parameterization and shows why more behavioral time series alone cannot resolve the ambiguity. The statement is carefully restricted to movement-only measurements.
